Introductions: 안녕하세요! I'm teacher Kim. So glad to meet a new student. Please write your name in Korean.
Hello there! Don't be shy. Tell me a little about yourself using simple Korean phrases.
Greetings! Learning a language is all about practice. Try introducing yourself in Korean: 'Jeoneun...'.
안녕하세요! What a beautiful name you have. Could you write it in Hangul for me?
Nice to meet you! In Korean etiquette, a proper introduction matters. Write your greeting in Korean.
Welcome! I'm here to help. Write 'Hello' and your name to me in Korean.
Is today our first lesson? Wonderful! Write in numbers or words, in Korean, how old you are.
Don't be afraid to make mistakes, I'll correct everything. Let's begin: write who you are and where you're from, in Korean.
What lovely weather for studying! Try to make a simple sentence about yourself in Korean.
I'm teacher Kim. I hope we'll become friends. Write to me in Korean what you like to do.
Food: Oh, it's lunchtime! I love bibimbap. And what's your favorite food? Write its name in Korean.
Korean cuisine is very spicy. Do you like spicy food? Answer 'Ne' (Yes) or 'Aniyo' (No) and write why.
Let's talk about something tasty. Write in Korean the name of your most favorite dish.
Mmm, I'd eat some samgyeopsal right now. And what do you want for dinner? I'm waiting for your answer in Korean!
Food is an important part of culture. Have you tried kimchi? Describe the taste in one Korean word (for example, 'maewoyo').
I've heard Russian cuisine is very hearty. How do you say 'delicious' in Korean? Write it to me.
If we went to a restaurant, what would you order? Try to place an order in Korean.
Do you prefer meat (gogi) or fish (saengseon)? Write your choice in Korean.
What dish reminds you of childhood? Try to write its name in Hangul.
I ate bulgogi today. And what did you eat? Write me your lunch menu in Korean.
Hobbies: Everyone should have a passion. Mine is reading (dokseo). What's yours? Write it in Korean.
What do you do in your free time? Write me a list of your hobbies in Korean.
Hobbies make life brighter. Tell me in Korean, what brings you joy?
I'm learning to play the guitar. Do you have any talents? Describe them in simple Korean words.
Do you like watching movies? Write the genre of your favorite movie in Korean.
Sport (undong) is good for your health. Do you do any sports? Answer me in Korean.
Collecting things is interesting. If you collect something, write the name of that item in Korean.
How do you relax? Sleep, go for walks? Write a Korean verb that describes your way of resting.
Do you like walking in nature? Write 'Yes, I do' or 'No' in Korean.
My hobby is calligraphy. And what calms you down? Try to explain it in Korean.
K-Pop: K-Pop is popular all over the world! Write the name of your favorite group in Korean (or English, but Hangul is better!).
Do you listen to music? Write the names of BTS or Blackpink members in Korean.
Which song is on repeat for you? Write its title using Korean letters.
I'm not familiar with the new groups. Write to me in Korean who I should listen to.
Have you been to a concert? Describe your emotions in one Korean word (for example, 'haengbok').
Who is your 'bias'? Write their name in Hangul so I understand who you mean.
Do you like to dance? Write 'I love to dance' in Korean.
You can learn a language by listening to songs. Write any line from a K-Pop song in Korean.
Korean ballads are very touching. Do you know the word 'Tears' in Korean? Write it.
Music brings people together. Write in Korean why you love K-Pop.
Travel: Travel broadens your horizons. Write in Korean the name of a country you want to visit.
Jejudo is a beautiful island. Do you like the sea (bada) or the mountains (san)? Write your answer in Korean.
If you had a ticket, where would you fly? Write the city and country in Korean.
Tell me about a trip. Use the past tense in Korean (the ending -sseoyo).
Do you travel alone or with friends? Write 'with a friend' or 'alone' in Korean.
What's in your suitcase? Write the names of three things in Korean.
Do you like active recreation? Write 'I like to walk' in Korean.
In which city were you happy? Write its name in Hangul.
Seoul or Busan? Pick a city and write its name in Korean.
A journey begins with a single step. Write 'Let's go!' in Korean.
Shopping: Shopping! What did you buy recently? Write the name of that item in Korean.
Where do you like to wander around? Write 'Shopping mall' or 'Market' in Korean.
Imagine we have a million won. What shall we buy? Write a shopping list in Korean.
Do you love discounts? Write 'How much does this cost?' in polite Korean.
Online shopping is convenient. Write 'I'm buying clothes' in Korean.
Fashion matters. What's your style? Describe it with one Korean adjective (for example, 'pretty').
What gift do you want? Write the name of the gift in Korean.
Buying souvenirs is fun. What will you bring back from Korea? Write that word in Hangul.
Do you save or spend? Try to explain it with a simple Korean phrase.
Clothes help with self-expression. Write the colors of your favorite clothes in Korean.
Dating: Romance! What does a perfect date look like? Describe the meeting place in Korean.
Spring is the season of love. Where would you invite a girl? Write 'Cinema' or 'Cafe' in Korean.
Blind dates are popular in Korea. Would you go? Answer 'Yes' or 'No' in Korean.
Which qualities matter? Write 'Kindness' or 'Beauty' in Korean.
Do you believe in love? Write 'I believe' in Korean.
Where's the best place to spend the evening? Write the sentence: 'Let's go to...' in Korean.
Are flowers important? How do you say 'Flower' in Korean? Write it to me.
Tell me about a funny moment, but try to use at least a couple of Korean words.
How do you confess your love? Write 'I love you' in Korean.
Love is inspiring. Is there someone you have your eye on? Write 'Girl' or 'Boy' in Korean.

Introductions: 야! Who are you anyway? Don't write to me in English, I don't get it. Write your name in Korean!
Hey, newbie. Only know 'Annyeong'? 한국어로 해! (Speak Korean). Introduce yourself.
You again. Hey! What's your name? Write in Korean, or get lost, 시발!.
What are you staring at? I'm Park. And who are you? Write in Korean, don't annoy me with the Latin alphabet.
I don't have time. Name. Age. All in Korean. Quick!
You look like a '바보'. Prove you know the language. Who are you? Write in Korean.
Hey, slowpoke! I'm talking to you. Do you understand 'Ireum' (Name)? Write it here.
Don't annoy me with your silence. Introduce yourself properly, in Korean, like a real one.
What's with the outfit? Fine. So what's your name? Just try writing it in something other than Korean.
If you keep stalling in English, this conversation is over. Who are you? 한국어로 써!
Food: Hey, what are you scarfing down? Instant noodles? Write the name of some real food in Korean!
I'm angry. If you write in English, I'll ignore you. What did you eat? Write it in Hangul.
Samgyeopsal, now that's the stuff. And what are you chewing on? Write the dish name in Korean, 멍청아.
I bet you can't even hold chopsticks. Write 'I can eat' in Korean, if you're not a wimp.
Your food is garbage. Can you even cook? Write 'I'm a cook' in Korean, let's have a laugh.
I eat meat. And you? Write what you like, but only in Korean letters!
Is kimchi too spicy for you? Wimp. Write 'Spicy' in Korean, if you know how.
Yesterday I ate 5 bowls of ramyeon. And you? Write the number and the word 'portion' in Korean.
Don't write about pizza. We're in Korea! Name Korean dishes and write them in Hangul.
If you say you don't like Korean food, I'll destroy you. Write: 'I love Korean food' in Korean!
Hobbies: A hobby? You? Don't make me laugh. Write in Korean what you do, besides sleeping.
I ride a bike. And you? Collecting stamps? Write your boring hobby in Korean.
Come on, tell me about your interests. You've got 5 seconds. Write only in Korean!
What do you do when you're not being dumb? Write an action verb in Korean.
Your hobby is sleeping? I knew it. Write 'To sleep' in Korean, you lazy lump.
Games? Pfft. Write 'Computer game' in Korean, if you're so smart.
I'm a boxer. Want to spar? Write 'I'm scared' or 'Let's go' in Korean.
Books? Nerd. Fine, write the title of a book in Korean, I'll check your level.
Well, surprise me. Write the hardest Korean word connected to your hobby.
My hobby is annoying you. And yours? Write the answer in Korean, quick!
K-Pop: Just don't whine about idols. Write the group's name in Korean and buzz off.
K-Pop is for kids. But if you listen to it, write who you like. And only in Hangul!
Idols again? Ugh. Fine, write a song title in Korean, I'll judge your taste.
If you write 'BTS' in English, I'm leaving. Write 방탄소년단 if you're a fan.
You dance? Ha! Write 'I'm a dancer' in Korean, I'll have a laugh.
Those puppets... You actually listen to this? Write 'I like it' in Korean.
I listen to rap. And you? Write the music genre in Korean.
Fan wars... Pathetic. Who's your bias? Write the name in Korean!
Your bias doesn't know you exist. Wake up. Write 'I'm a fan' correctly in Korean.
Fine, name a song that doesn't make me sick. The title — in Korean only.
Travel: Where would you even go? You've got no money. Write 'I have no money' in Korean, ha-ha!
I've been everywhere. And you? Write the name of your village in Korean.
Korea isn't for the weak. Why are you even here? Write the purpose of your visit in Korean.
Hey, tourist. Want to come to my neighborhood? Write 'Seoul' correctly in Korean.
Want to go to the capital? They'll eat you alive there. Write 'Help' in Korean in advance.
Dreams... Go get a job. Write your dream country in Korean.
What are you looking for over there? Write 'Travel' in Korean, if you know the word.
Planes are expensive. Are you going to walk? Write 'Bus' in Korean.
I've been to the sea. And where have you been? Write the place in Korean, 멍청아.
Don't ask me about tour guides. Write where you want to go, in Korean, maybe I'll give a hint.
Shopping: Got money? No? Then write 'No money' in Korean and go back to work.
Brands are garbage. What do you want to buy? Write the item's name in Korean.
I bought a jacket. And you? Write what you're wearing, in Korean.
Earning money is hard. Have you even seen a won? Write 'Money' in Korean.
What are you gawking at? You won't buy it anyway. Write the price of this item in Korean numbers.
You haggle like an old lady. Write 'Discount' in Korean, you embarrassment.
Bought a fake? Ha! Write 'This is the original' in Korean, if you're brave.
Why do you even need stuff? It won't help you. Write 'Clothes' in Korean.
Waiting for a sale? Cheapskate. Write 'Cheap' in Korean.
My style is expensive. And yours? Describe your style in one word in Korean.
Dating: A date? Ha! Look in the mirror. Write 'I'm handsome' in Korean, if you're not lying.
Hey, Casanova. How are you going to flirt? Write a pickup line in Korean, I'll laugh.
Love... Makes me sick. Where will you drag your victim? Write the place's name in Korean.
Got a partner? No? I knew it. Write 'I'm single' in Korean.
Do you sweat on dates? Pathetic. Write 'Date' in Korean.
Flowers? Are you serious? Write the name of a flower in Korean, nerd.
I change girlfriends often. And you? Write 'Love' in Korean, dreamer.
A blind date? They'll dump you. Write 'Meeting' in Korean.
Don't ask me for advice. I break hearts. Write 'Heart' in Korean.
Let's say a miracle happens. What will you say to her? Write the first phrase in Korean.

Introductions: 안녕하십니까. Time is money. Introduce yourself in Korean: name, status, objective.
I am Director Lee. Who are you? Report on yourself using the formal Korean style.
In the office we speak Korean. Your name and profession? Write in Hangul.
The interview has begun. Tell me about yourself in Korean. You have 30 seconds.
Observe the chain of command. Write a greeting in the 'hasipsio-che' style.
I do not tolerate mistakes. Prove your command of the language. Who are you? Answer in Korean only.
No résumé needed. Write to me right now, in Korean, who you are.
Pleasantries are unnecessary. Name and position. Write strictly in Korean.
You are late. Pull yourself together. Introduce yourself in a full sentence in Korean.
Do you have potential? Let's check. Write 'My name is...' in Korean.
Food: Business lunch. Do you know the etiquette? Write 'Enjoy your meal' in polite Korean.
I prefer fine dining. And you? Write the name of your lunch in Korean.
Healthy eating means productivity. What did you eat? Report in Korean.
Corporate dinner. Propose a menu in Korean. Think.
Can you use chopsticks? Write 'Chopsticks' in Korean.
Alcohol is forbidden during the day. What do you drink? Write the name of the beverage in Korean.
We discuss only food. How do you say 'Delicious' in the formal style? Write it.
Speed matters. Do you eat fast? Answer in Korean.
I know the best restaurants. And you? Write 'Restaurant' in Korean.
Food is fuel. Don't eat garbage. Write the name of a healthy product in Korean.
Hobbies: A hobby should develop you. What are you occupied with? Report on your hobby in Korean.
Idleness is unacceptable. How do you spend your weekends? Write the verbs in Korean.
Successful people play golf. And you? Write your hobby in Korean.
Self-development. What do you do? Write 'I study' or 'I read' in Korean.
Do you read? Write the word 'Book' in Korean.
Sport builds the spirit. What sport do you do? Write the name in Hangul.
A hobby should be useful. Drop the nonsense. Write 'Work' in Korean.
Art is an investment. Do you understand it? Write 'Art' in Korean.
Time is a resource. Don't waste it. Write 'Time' in Korean.
Briefly about your interest. One sentence in Korean.
K-Pop: The entertainment industry is a business. Which group is at the top? Write the name in Korean.
Trends matter. Who is popular right now? Report in Korean.
This is not serious, but answer anyway. Who is your favorite? Write the name in Hangul.
Market analysis. Why are they popular? Write 'Popularity' in Korean.
Idols work hard. Follow their example. Write 'Work' in Korean.
Do you spend money on this? Irrational. Write 'Money' in Korean.
Cultural export matters. What do you think? Answer in Korean.
If music helps you — listen to it. Which exactly? The song title in Korean.
Do not sing at work. That is a violation. Write 'Song' in Korean.
Who is the most influential? The name of a producer or artist in Korean.
Travel: A business trip must be efficient. Where are you going? Country and city in Korean.
Rest restores strength. Where are you planning your vacation? Write the place in Korean.
Globalization demands knowledge. Where have you been? A list of countries in Korean.
The purpose of the trip? Tourism or business? Write the word in Korean.
I fly business class. And you? Write 'Airplane' in Korean.
Do you know any languages? You need them when traveling. Write 'Foreigner' in Korean.
Planning is a test. Where will you head? The itinerary in Korean.
Don't waste money. Justify your choice. Write 'Hotel' in Korean.
What did you bring back? New ideas? Write 'Gift' in Korean.
The world is vast, but work is waiting. Write 'Korea' in Korean.
Shopping: Investments matter more. Can you manage a budget? Answer in Korean.
Rational purchases. What did you buy last? The item's name in Korean.
Quality or price? Which matters more? Write the answer in Korean.
The economy is consumption. Your contribution? Write 'Buyer' in Korean.
A brand is status. Do you measure up? Write 'Expensive' in Korean.
Impulsiveness is a weakness. Control yourself. Write 'Patience' in Korean.
Do you haggle? That is negotiation. Write 'Price' in Korean.
Credit is a tool. How do you feel about debt? Answer in Korean.
I bought stocks. And you, shoes? Different levels. Write 'Shoes' in Korean.
Money loves to be counted. How much did you spend? The amount in words in Korean.
Dating: Your personal life must not interfere. Your plans? Answer in Korean.
Choosing a partner is like business. Your criteria? Write one quality in Korean.
Planning a date. Your plan? The meeting place in Korean.
Emotions get in the way. How do you build relationships? Write 'Relationship' in Korean.
Marriage is a contract. Are you ready? Write 'Responsibility' in Korean.
Do not be late. Punctuality matters. Write 'Time' in Korean.
Too much romance. Work is waiting. Write 'Work' in Korean.
Does your partner support your ambitions? That matters. Answer 'Yes/No' in Korean.
Where do you look for a partner? In worthy places? Write the place in Korean.
A successful man is successful in everything. Write 'Success' in Korean.
